document.title: Analysis and Evaluation Report on the Expected Life of the Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer
document.document_type: Expected Life Analysis and Evaluation Report

intended_use_items.description: Measure human body temperature by receiving the infrared energy of the human body forehead

requirements.description: Transportation and storage relative humidity: 15%RH ~ 95%RH, non-condensing
Transportation and storage atmospheric pressure: 70 kPa ~ 106 kPa
Reliability target: 90% reliability at 90% confidence level

tests.method_reference: IEC 62506:2013 Methods for product accelerated testing
tests.acceleration_model: Arrhenius model (temperature and humidity as acceleration stress)
tests.acceleration_formula: Weibull Distribution and Binomial Distribution Synthesis formula
tests.report_reference: Annex I – Accelerated life testing report

design_inputs.description: 365 working days per year, 3 times per day = 1095 times per year
Each operation (startup, measurement, auto shutdown) takes 20 seconds
Application environment: 25℃, 50% RH; Accelerated environment: 40℃, 95% RH

regulations.name: Guiding Principles for Technical Review of the Expected Life Registration of Active Medical Devices

semantic_fragments.content: The product mainly uses the environment for the home environment, which is the high-tech Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer to measure the human body temperature by receiving the infrared energy of the human body forehead. The Expected Life is 5 years. The product mainly consists of a plastic casing, IR temperature sensor, MCU, LCD display screen, buzzer and batteries. The host is a critical factor influencing the overall product expected life. The product lifespan is confirmed through accelerated life testing of the entire unit. The evaluation follows the path of direct verification on the product.

Cleaning and Disinfection procedure: The thermometer is designed for home use. If there are multiple users, please clean the device in between uses with the following steps: 1. Use an alcohol swab or tissue moistened with alcohol (70% Isopropyl) to clean the thermometer casing thoroughly, ideally for more than 15 seconds. 2. Allow the thermometer to dry for at least 5 minutes before taking a temperature. 3. After cleaning, if the device is not visually clean when observed with magnification and adequate lighting, please repeat the clean steps above.

Evaluation Method Overview table: Item = Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer; Influencing factors = Frequency, use time, ambient temperature and humidity; Model = PT9L; Attribute = independent research and development; Decomposition relation type = No replaceable parts; During the Expected Life / failure rate = 5 years; Evaluation methodology = Accelerated life testing report (see Annex I); Evaluation completion unit = ANDON HEALTH CO., LTD.; Whether an unacceptable risk occurs during the Expected Life = No (See Risk Analysis Report for details).

Acceleration factor calculation: For electronic products, activation energy Ea = 0.8 eV. Ts = normal temperature 25℃ + 273 = 298K; Tu = high temperature 40℃ + 273 = 313K; k = Boltzmann constant = 8.62×10⁻⁵ eV/K; RHs = 50% RH (normal use); RHu = 95% RH (accelerated stress); n = humidity acceleration rate constant = 2. Calculated AF = 16.058. Test time calculation uses the Weibull Distribution and Binomial Distribution Synthesis formula with β = 1.5 and sample size = 1.
